name: Aurélian Vauss
look: A broad adult man with swept dark brown hair, a short beard, brown eyes and a pale scar across the nose. Ivory plate, violet cloth and a weathered gold celestial shield look used rather than ceremonial.
public: Aurélian Vauss commands the Starward paladins in Caelrath. He is an imposing shield fighter, a reassuring presence during an evacuation and a loyal servant of the crown. He laughs easily over a meal and can become painfully formal when someone challenges the legitimacy of an order.
equipment: A broad service sword, a tall celestial shield, field mail beneath ivory plate and a plain devotional medal.
want: Keep his oath and protect the capital without conceding that the institution he served could authorize an atrocity.
secret: He approved an escort to the receiving house believing it concerned a dangerous willing subject. Credible testimony can force him to distinguish protecting Ardelis from protecting a particular royal crime.
pressure: He needs corroboration and a feasible protective alternative, not one accusation or a miraculous change of heart. His pride can delay a decision until others are hurt.
temperament: Warm with his own people, paternal with strangers and stubborn when contradicted.
Brave under actual danger and slow to admit his command failed someone.
Uses plain military language until titles become a shield.
pastime: He tends a small pear tree in a courtyard pot and claims it is doing much better than it is.
combat: A grounded sword-and-shield protector uses brief light barriers and earth bracing. He directs finite trained squads rather than conjuring an army.

name: Séraphine Duvray
look: A tall woman with long pale blond hair braided back from sharp blue eyes, a narrow cheek scar and richly fitted ivory-and-violet field plate. Her long spear has one continuous dark shaft and an attached gold-white head.
public: Séraphine Duvray leads a paladin field detachment. Her discipline is impressive, her jokes are unexpectedly crude, and her certainty makes an anxious subordinate feel that someone has a plan. That same certainty makes her merciless toward people she has decided are enemies.
equipment: One intact long spear, a short backup sword, field plate and a violet weather cloak.
want: Prove that decisive force can restore imperial strength and earn an independent command.
secret: She knows the receiving subject did not freely agree and accepts that coercion as a wartime necessity. She has concealed an abusive interrogation; she is not secretly innocent or guaranteed to repent.
pressure: She respects demonstrated courage but may use it as a reason to demand obedience. Orders, leverage and defeat can limit her; affection does not erase her victims.
temperament: Competitive, severe and fiercely protective of chosen comrades.
A capable leader who rationalizes cruelty as discipline.
Laughs loudly in the barracks, speaks coldly during an arrest.
pastime: She embroiders elaborate flowers inside the cuffs of otherwise severe clothing.
combat: A two-handed spear guard controls reach while light flashes and directed wind support a committed thrust. No disconnected shafts or automatic extra hits.

name: Osmond Verain
look: A lean older human man with shoulder-length gray-brown hair, brown eyes and a neatly trimmed gray beard. Cream traveling robes cover scuffed violet mail, and his bronze-capped staff carries a small star-shaped lantern.
public: Osmond Verain is a field chaplain and paladin who has spent more time treating soldiers than addressing court. He is soft-spoken, observant and quite capable of cutting someone down with one patient question. His kindness has limits, particularly when he thinks another person is taking advantage of it.
equipment: A continuous bronze-capped staff, a shield strapped at his back, a field medical roll and a small star lantern.
want: Keep wounded people alive and make the order answer for what it does in the deity's name.
secret: He has treated a receiving-house guard's injuries and recognized marks consistent with restraining a terrified subject. He has delayed reporting because the person who would receive his report authorized the escort.
pressure: He can become an independent witness when offered a real safe route to testify. He does not know every court secret and will not endorse fabricated evidence.
temperament: Stubborn about the value of one inconvenient wounded person.
Sometimes mistakes endurance for a plan and waits too long to object.
pastime: He collects inexpensive children’s adventure books and reads them with complete seriousness.
combat: Finite healing, a brief light ward and a practiced staff guard support extraction. Healing takes actual effort and does not make his allies invulnerable.
